requirement: Staff CI dashboard reports exact-head PR checks, runner assignments and actionable lifecycle filters

oracle.invariant: A green old SHA or skipped-only checks cannot make a PR Ready. Signed-out and nonstaff requests never reach GitHub. Job runner observations join only the exact check id, run attempt and PR head SHA. CI job waiting and active job filters are separate from GitHub merge queue; merged PRs do not appear in running stages. Agent handoff names the PR, head commit and failed checks, and explains that merged failures do not block merge. Unread PRs show New and semibold rows; read status belongs to each Tracy account and survives refresh, head and CI status changes. The whole-run deadline stops the next child after the preceding real check completes, independently of subprocess speed. Automatic merge targets only develop and never uses a stale head, incomplete checks or a pending/changes-requested review. Branch and Updated/Created/Merged date scope read paginated GitHub history beyond 30 merged PRs before table paging. Custom calendar days have an inclusive local start and exclusive next-day UTC upper bound; another filter scope never inherits stale rows. Only active continuous viewport exposure for 3 seconds, or hover/focus for 2 seconds, marks a row read. Mark all covers the selected author and loaded branch/date scope across pages; unsuccessful writes keep unread badges.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
